Thanks for the ping, Marissa — looping Karthik for procurement clearance. Aisha, welcome — appreciate the attachments.

We can consider a provisional "invoice-only" lane for small pilots where a PO cannot be issued in time, subject to conditions below. To move forward we need the following items submitted to procurement:
1) Signed one-page SOW (scope + total not-to-exceed) — attach to ticket
2) Completed onboarding_form.pdf (we received this but it needs the legal entity tax ID)
3) Proof of payment history (minimum two invoices showing prior payments) — redacted ok
4) Billing contact and AP email (we have billing@cloudkeen.com)

Operational conditions for a 90-day provisional approval:
- Approval is temporary for 90 calendar days from first invoice date; procurement will re-evaluate prior to day 75.
- Invoice net terms: Net 30; Redwood Finance to route invoices to finance@redwood.ai for reconciliation.
- Ceiling: total cumulative charges during the pilot must not exceed $25,000 without explicit Procurement sign-off.
- Security: no PII data processed until contract/legal confirms data handling — product team will flag if needed.

I can provisionally approve once the SOW and tax ID are uploaded and HubSpot/Procurement ticket is created. I created PR-1893 in procurement (link below) — please attach.

Next steps:
- Aisha: sign SOW and update onboarding_form with tax ID + AP contact
- Marissa: attach to PR-1893 and confirm billing email
- Karthik: will review evidence and issue formal 90-day exception if everything validates

Procurement ticket: https://procurement.redwood.internal/tickets/PR-1893

Soojin Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Reviewed PR-1893 and attachments. I pulled the redacted payment history and the signed SOW (received just now as signed-sow.pdf). Based on risk tiering this qualifies as low-risk (existing marketplace seller with on-file KYC and two prior payments).

Formal decision: Procurement authorizes a temporary invoice-only onboarding lane for CloudKeen Inc. for 90 days under the conditions Soojin listed. Caveats:
- Maximum cumulative spend during pilot: $25,000.
- Finance will place holds on invoices that exceed Net-30 or missing AP contact.
- Procurement will close the exception at day 75 and requires confirmation of PO issuance or continued vendor setup timeline.

Aisha — welcome aboard. Please ensure the signed SOW and the onboarding_form with tax ID are in PR-1893 and share the first invoice to finance@redwood.ai.

I will log the exception in the procurement ledger and send a short confirmation doc (DocuSign link) to finalize.
